verdict.rationale: Kimi is a general AI assistant, so connecting a cloud drive, email and calendar is a fair question for it. The pack shows no documented connectors for any of the three. The only nearby evidence is a generic plugins/skills mechanism and a "Kimi Claw 接入飞书" (Kimi Claw connects to Feishu) help topic. Neither shows the assistant reading a user's drive, mail or calendar to answer questions, so both count only as adjacent features.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers
